lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Forty years on the line
In Houston heat and rain
Pipe and steel and long hard days
You never once complained

You came home with tired hands
And a grin that still could shine
Built a life out of your grit
And gave it all in time

[Pre-Chorus]
Three kids grew up strong
On the love you laid down
Every mile you carried
Still circles back around

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob
Seventy years strong
We love you, Bob
For all you gave along

Happy birthday, Bob
Our anchor in the flood
We thank you, Bob
With all our heart and blood

[Verse 2]
Now you’re out on Lake Conroe
With your rod and folding chair
Morning quiet on the water
And the sunlight in your hair

You watch the cork go under
Like you’ve got all day to spend
And we smile when you come home
With fish tales and your friends

[Pre-Chorus]
Three kids grew up strong
On the love you laid down
Every mile you carried
Still circles back around

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob
Seventy years strong
We love you, Bob
For all you gave along

Happy birthday, Bob
Our anchor in the flood
We thank you, Bob
With all our heart and blood

[Bridge]
You taught us how to work
How to stand up straight
How to keep on showing up
And never call it late

Now the years are golden
And the boat drifts slow and free
Still the best part of our world
Is your hand in ours, and we

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob
Seventy years strong
We love you, Bob
For all you gave along

Happy birthday, Bob
Our anchor in the flood
We thank you, Bob
With all our heart and blood

[Outro]
Bob, you’re our home
Bob, you’re our pride
Happy seventieth, honey
With your family by your side
title: Lake Conroe BOB
